verdict.identity: Warren River system; representative mainstem identity only (Western Australia)
verdict.status: Supported representative system/mainstem identity; uniform whole-group and per-reach naming are not cleared.
verdict.identity_confidence: High for representative regional system identity; exact named-component boundaries unresolved.
verdict.scope: Selected historical baseline group only, with headwater and outlet distinctions retained.
verdict.korean_note: No direct Korean naming evidence acquired.

geometry_integrity.review_note: All decoded parts included in complete-path visual and numeric review. Equal part/reach counts do not prove a reach-to-part correspondence.

spatial_identity_check.method: Complete baseline path plotted, inspected and checked for every part, count, bound and hash; side-by-side comparison with complete official regional maps and course descriptions. No georegistered overlay or exact line fit.
spatial_identity_check.regional_course_comparison: The entire northeast-to-southwest path is consistent with the Tone-to-Warren corridor: inland headwaters southwest of Kojonup, southward approach east of Manjimup, westward lower valley and the coastal Warren mouth region southwest of Pemberton.
spatial_identity_check.named_transition_check: DWER explicitly places the Warren name downstream of the Tone-Perup confluence. The selected upstream course is regionally consistent with Tone, but the confluence has not been crosswalked to a rendered-part boundary.

component_scope.selected_path_relationship: Upstream association supported at regional-course level; exact reach-name boundaries not assigned.
Named transition explicitly supported by DWER; Perup is a tributary, not established as the selected upstream path.

component_scope.component: Lower Warren mouth and coastal terminal
component_scope.selected_path_relationship: Southern Ocean receiving-water context supported; exact mouth and any estuarine limit not surveyed.

spatial_identity_check.bounded_unresolved_scope: Tone-to-Warren and lower-river/estuarine/coastal boundaries remain unresolved at source-reach resolution. No distinct estuary name is established by these sources.

outlet_scope.regional_location: Warren mouth region southwest of Pemberton, Western Australia
outlet_scope.endpoint_interpretation: The regional outlet agrees with the official Warren course description. The retained source endpoint and rendered endpoint differ, so neither is treated as a surveyed current river-mouth boundary.

remaining_limits: Only the pinned historical baseline was checked; current deployment and original HydroRIVERS coordinate equality are not claimed.
No exact name-boundary crosswalk or universal component name is established.
